stages.name: plan
stages.reason: Vite origin migration: the era configuration imports "dotenv", which this capability has no translation for. A Vite 2 plugin usually loads without error under a current Vite plugin container it was never written against, so leaving it in place would produce a build nobody has established anything about. Add a translation for it, or remove it from the configuration deliberately.
